registered_accounts.source: Supabase > Snapside > main Production > Authentication > Users
registered_accounts.definition: Total registered auth accounts shown by the dashboard; internal and test accounts are not excluded. Not paying or retained customers.

ga4.source: Google Analytics reports snapshot and Home, All Users
ga4.scope_note: Web active users include site visitors; not registered product users. Internal/test traffic exclusions were not verified. The Home comparison is against the prior 28 days.

search_console.source: Search Console > Performance > compare last 28 days with previous period
search_console.scope_note: All web-search queries/pages/countries/devices. Small launch-period baseline. Observed growth is not causal attribution to an individual SEO or UX change. Search Console and GA4 periods differ by one day.

method: Aggregate values read from authenticated source UIs on 2026-10-18; no individual user information retained.

product_origin.problem: Manually logging work in Notion is easy to forget. Later, the reasons behind changes in Notion and Figma become hard to recover.
product_origin.design_direction: Automatically collect changes from connected tools and revisit them alongside context recorded in issues and notes.
product_origin.measurement_note: Founder motivation, not a claim established by user research or measured outcomes.
